- Try our state-of-the-art models<https://c.gle/APy2Ad07p2lXkvzErq3eUjP7nzu4DUkgEJmEN6ozAgDqNX21BqK422Xsb1FBhf-nX1RsmCMvQxDT_qsplojxV51jZQabXgYeHYV1n758kK6WHi7m6qTG_bQpAksxB49zUiBGltzlryPNHzOhm7iQBEGkqbXWaCo72ALLf4Lm2XB22eMfU-qTIL8bj04OMnGFDFMDumfeq0ZPD8UmOhak1C8c3gp_5sezERKjfwK6lY2NTHwPzua_bXaBwP-3DYu-tmA6tg>
Integrate the latest models from Google DeepMind in your apps with the Gemini API.

- Create applications from a prompt<https://c.gle/APy2Ad2TwG4uJpWi9r979uHE_-rrAS0KnJiXyn8L0YF865HjzD12zx7G6spR7cT9nZ1gH2YOcRbhtt-assdILqfgCaFvyJmiTj2QwgmbIEDiZCMnan0omXps-Vaup8jcXUVUVTh5X97aMqZPgOfYnzUln9WBnGMlcRlYewwY8fpBpLLKGadP3SxJ7hHtGS4jDBQV_h4JIfx5fsuIhsa3H-VJYw_O_RYl0oHUfn7__RqwuQgTWkrfJQ>
Go from concept to code with a single prompt. Our native code editor is seamlessly integrated with the Google Gen AI SDK, creating an efficient environment to build with the Gemini API.

- Build real-time agents<https://c.gle/APy2Ad3dYtmwbk9AGWc6KOK4GgMXPrxUEvmfCN3BTr4qBvJuJpzv_HzrgfNmMGcnBrZ1IQVmJZzZtAjSc65rN6mOkqRZJ8WQBY-wX2N_XdBeHmItcwDvhAZA_F3antbCXe2cXSRUfRkpuze_hzkiwaXSrI0rbamxv4HHq944lUw2KpRZvLSoOPZ7-8H3x4QjSBQu4Ws3Fvk4PzA79pd-26Jq5xxxZjEo833CIEAp>
Develop conversational AI agents and experiences that feel more intuitive and natural. Use real-time audio and video along with tools like Google Search to provide live, helpful, and context-aware responses.

- Use Veo and other generative media models<https://c.gle/APy2Ad36VnoA52MznZvw3jc9R_wzK8GQwlT-fYdRMuZaKmC_ThCFEExKdigAnti5i4IbqfVo-KyQpu1AcRVvVJZfA0t81mOQ3QD_CH9YyY9-9jf76vtppAZFtWYXmj5oKtPT8lDrJps6ha4_VMtmgT8Ogn8Ka8yGx3P5XNBG1NYrpuT6kzgombLgt0ZMcs4YWAosUCJt1q5jDJbBUxSQnPPgjula_B_XE2BBdl_LGd4KX21P7ECkn5YY-y6VME566Qds>
Integrate state-of-the-art video with Veo and photo-realistic images with Imagen into your apps.

- Get your Gemini API key<https://c.gle/APy2Ad2HJtHbh5w4OUHhbmVB2qL8PZv_Wv6ufIoWvKgcmMVaISN3iSkCMUrFXlJMTjOp-QBZtGXpPasrK7Sj0afyOQu__COq2X-TZxDCIMdIksMtraFIT_ZCiK2EpJfcAHzoOzcKAkW5yFFkaoLL42UOL6eRvCQnJXqFWUl5t83kKLs9MRXDPy7yZy3Ha3bXam-3HSZBr1d-omxCepjmen73P5g5YzmbHsoA2hq1Ro-cNzPF>
Start developing, deploying, and integrating Gemini models in your application with an API key.

Explore the Gemini API docs<https://c.gle/APy2Ad3RYICf3BRJrFte6cIIBmMU1d37GD8kXR1AU7ZP0PiTYde2TEwYAEToEqqitEkTMjhBCtpTD_rLo7nPjT7Gm6ZTxrZ8tgicwla6SG9ZMJRwfsRN3w-R19SOzTn2imb5JaJcEpmD0BB0GQlN-UXwWIi1xoQGinm5pcVjMm0RhssjXHKueStuAWlNj5cskUehWS3eEKFfkLsMZm4Oy2WH4Pl_LiPo8mEhOvI> to learn more about the models and capabilities.

Build with Gemini API<https://c.gle/APy2Ad1gNciU4dnaaZqRElQ7MImOawOx2Li88KQHSkdekO6IPdInCWGi8SkPrWeik1lLy3d2Z3HcfjinpZXrm69CmgXLxNACtzaNKHXgkKECYoT3mT6jKNLtSAo1Rm2RUyUtRNL7b7YOKQq3hKfarOj7gO_fXuzAC1Gwm4h386ogfLiM_QC3FELUzhlvtCXFlVRQfpSx3mWzmdGZr-vfmAmJsqVUuM1CccSsOg>

Need help? Join the forum<https://c.gle/APy2Ad1hBVvEo-l7GTPRlJYK-vpJsguGUj1suIL_8TdaRaTOJm8LttQ52O7o6wJ1xR8BXMAwM0CHc--uMPQ07AImv4LF5zJYwFoAbGBp57jhkkiSozQyz2Pd98QMCxCscSN4UpU5J1e-MVNaRt92ubAm_6JsRXGFuLndFWAXtw1XagTNwXmxaqoPY_UvvR9YkXNt8qCrKH2luPE2FhbGJ9bpsbe8usbxMpQt> to ask questions and connect with other developers.

Thanks,

The Google AI Studio team
